name: Fellowship
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital importance of fellowship as a reflection of our relationship with God and others. The examples of Enoch and Noah walking with God demonstrate a close, obedient fellowship that leads to righteousness and divine approval. Conversely, the warnings against forming covenants with ungodly peoples and joining their assemblies highlight the dangers of fellowship with the wicked, which can lead to sin and spiritual harm. Thus, biblical fellowship calls believers to maintain purity by aligning themselves with God and His people while avoiding harmful associations.
